verdict.rationale: LegalOS's own pages clearly state the human-review side: every petition is reviewed by a licensed immigration attorney before filing, under a named lead attorney. Several pages repeat the 'attorney-reviewed petition package' claim. The AI side, however, appears only as a vague mention of attorneys 'paired with AI workflows that move visas and green cards forward faster'. Nothing says which drafting or review steps are automated. Missing for 10: an explicit description of what AI does in petition drafting and review, a stated split between AI-automated and attorney-checked steps, and independent corroboration of the review process.
